note: Channel-owned typography role model. Ranges are preferred calibration bands, not universal aesthetic gates. Every live choice requires real pre-render glyph measurement and post-render bounds/computed-font verification.
maxMainFamiliesRule: The two primary families are EB Garamond plus either Inter or IBM Plex Sans. IBM Plex Mono is a restricted utility face and is permitted only for eyebrow, footer, and trackedClosingSignature roles.

turkishGlyphSupport.requirement: Every family used in a live render (headline, body, headline emphasis, eyebrow, footer, or tracked closing signature) must render the full Turkish character set correctly: İ i I ı, Ş ş, Ğ ğ, Ü ü, Ö ö, Ç ç, and Turkish punctuation/quote conventions.
turkishGlyphSupport.verification: Verify per-family via real fontkit glyph coverage measurement (not visual assumption) before the family is used in a live Kaduse render. Record the result against the family's row in font-pool.json rather than re-deriving it per post.

brandProductFamily.label: Brand/product family
brandProductFamily.notes: Secondary rank to the hero headline and to Kaduse's own logo -- never the single dominant text element. Establishes which manufacturer/product line this is without competing with the post's own creative thesis.

productModel.label: Product model
productModel.notes: May sit adjacent to or as part of the hero headline's composition when the model name IS the creative hook; otherwise ranks below the hero headline per the dominant-gesture rule (creative-north-star-and-art-direction-programme.md §4).

skuVariant.label: SKU / variant
skuVariant.notes: Functional identifier, not a creative element. Fine to set as a small tag/pill; must still clear the minimum-contrast gate against its own background region, not the canvas average.

heroHeadline.label: Hero headline
heroHeadline.notes: May be the dominant gesture, but dominance is contextual and may instead belong to the product, product detail, statistic, date, or clinical illustration. Size bands guide hierarchy and calibration; they are not universal area or scale gates.

supportingLine.label: Supporting line
supportingLine.notes: Qualifies or extends the hero headline. Must stay visually subordinate to it (smaller size and/or lighter weight) -- never sized or weighted to compete for dominance.

featureFact.label: Feature / fact text
featureFact.notes: HARD FLOOR: never render below minSizePx to solve overflow -- overflow is solved by shortening copy, restructuring the fact cluster, or choosing a different density band, never by shrinking fact text past this floor (VISUAL-SYSTEM.md §1). Weight is medium/semibold, heavier than a typical body paragraph, specifically so facts read as content, not fine print. Prefer short label+value pairs or a tight fact cluster over paragraph-style sentences.

annotation.label: Annotation
annotation.example: garanti koşulları için bkz. — kaynak/tarih notu
annotation.notes: Smallest permitted role. Never carries a claim, price, date, or fact that must itself be legible at feed-thumbnail size without zooming -- if the content matters at thumbnail scale, it belongs in featureFact, not here.

cta.label: CTA
cta.notes: Distinguish from the hero headline by weight/treatment/containment (e.g. set inside a footer pill or frame-connected block, often uppercase), not by introducing a third family. One CTA per post.

footer.label: Footer
footer.notes: Kaduse signature / trust line / series identifier text (see feed-grammar.json footer rules). Keep a consistent size band across posts for feed continuity -- do not vary footer type size post-to-post without a stated reason.

eyebrow.label: Eyebrow
eyebrow.notes: Optional orientation device. Uses IBM Plex Mono only and must remain outside the stable logo zone.

headlineEmphasis.label: Headline emphasis
headlineEmphasis.notes: Optional INLINE_ITALIC or ITALIC_NEGATIVE_TAG using the real EB Garamond Italic face. It remains part of one grammatical headline and never behaves as a CTA or sticker.

trackedClosingSignature.label: Tracked closing signature
trackedClosingSignature.notes: Preferred feed-continuity closure when compositionally justified; IBM Plex Mono only.
